Our Story

A Little Piece of
Cajun Country

✦
"Good food doesn't need to be fancy — just honest, warm, and made with love."

Buddy's Drive Inn is more than a restaurant — it's a Pierre Part tradition. Tucked in the heart of Cajun country, we've been serving up comfort food with Louisiana soul to neighbors, families, and anyone who finds their way to our door.

From our famous Chicken Littles to hand-battered homemade onion rings and fresh Gulf shrimp po'boys, every dish is made with care. Roll through the drive-through, grab a booth, or pick up for the whole crew — you're always welcome here.
